```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'USD'
),
order_handset as (
    select o.order_id,
           p.model_name
    from orders o
    join order_items i on i.order_id = o.order_id
    join products p on p.sku = i.sku
    where not p.is_accessory
),
captures_ranked as (
    select a.attempt_id,
           a.order_id,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           a.method,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and s.country_code = 'AE'
),
captured as (
    select oh.model_name as key,
           sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting) as amount
    from captures_ranked c
    join order_handset oh on oh.order_id = c.order_id
    join fx on fx.currency = c.currency and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
    where c.capture_rank = 1
      and c.method = 'card'
      and c.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
    group by oh.model_name
),
refunded as (
    select oh.model_name as key,
           sum(rf.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting) as amount
    from refunds rf
    join payment_attempts a on a.attempt_id = rf.attempt_id
    join orders o on o.order_id = rf.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join order_handset oh on oh.order_id = o.order_id
    join fx on fx.currency = rf.currency and fx.rate_date = rf.business_date
    where rf.status = 'processed'
      and a.method = 'card'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and s.country_code = 'AE'
      and rf.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
    group by oh.model_name
)
select captured.key as key,
       cast(coalesce(refunded.amount, 0) / nullif(captured.amount, 0) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from captured
left join refunded on refunded.key = captured.key
order by value desc, key asc
```
